{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check how many have sample_seq > 1 (i.e., re-tested)
df_retested = df[df['sample_seq'] > 1]
print(f"Number of re-tested patients (sample_seq > 1): {len(df_retested)}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Display first few rows to inspect
print(df.head())"}
